libs.note: BH-9799. bin/posthog-lookup.sh <project> "<hogql>" | --report api-failures|web-vitals: one HogQL query with the project's PostHog key (catalog/signal-sources.d/<project>.json). Applied by the script with lib_env_apply posthog-lookup. An out-of-range value is the default, never a clamp.

knobs.note: curl -m for the one PostHog query. The same 25 s as bin/sentry-lookup.sh, inside a medic step budget. Read as ${POSTHOG_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_S:-25}.
The most rows printed (and the LIMIT of the canned reports). More rows print one '(posthog: <n> more rows not shown)' line. Read as ${POSTHOG_LOOKUP_MAX_ROWS:-50}.
The window of --report api-failures. Read as ${POSTHOG_REPORT_API_FAILURES_H:-24}.
The window of --report web-vitals. Read as ${POSTHOG_REPORT_WEB_VITALS_D:-7}.

The PostHog event --report api-failures counts (properties endpoint and status). Must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$, else api_error. project-6 sends no such event yet, so the report answers '(posthog: no rows)' until the app sends it. Read as ${POSTHOG_REPORT_API_FAILURE_EVENT:-api_error}.
